messages:
alex: Quick q — we're surfacing per-tenant SLO alerts in the console. If a tenant picks a tiny debounce/window it can fan out to paging and cause noise. Do we throttle at routing layer or prevent it in the UI? Need a call before the rollout tomorrow.

maria: I vote routing-layer limits + console warnings. UX should allow override but we should enforce a hard cap server-side. Otherwise one tenant can DOS our oncall channels. :grimacing:

kevin: Routing-level hard caps sound right. Suggest: soft_warn at 4 notifiers, hard_cap at 8. Also we need per-tenant notify quota (not just concurrency) e.g. 100/min.

sasha: Agreed re telemetry. If UI blocks it we lose signals for experiments. Soft warning + audit log + opt-in override makes sense. Need metric names for alerting/monitoring.

kevin: current metrics: slo.alert.fanout.count (histogram), slo.alert.pager.rate_per_tenant (counter). We'll add slo.alert.fanout.overrides when people dismiss warnings.

maria: Can we compute an estimated paging_rate in the UI so users see an impact preview? That'd reduce accidental misconfigurations.

alex: Good idea. UX preview + warning text: "Estimated pages per hour: X — this may trigger oncall paging." Make copy actionable.

sasha: I'll own UI copy and preview. Want to know exact formula. Kevin, can you paste routing config prop we can use? 

kevin: Example config snippet:
```
routing_policy:
  fanout_hard_cap: 8
  fanout_soft_warn: 4
  per_tenant_notify_quota_per_min: 100
  audit_on_override: true
```
Use that for the preview calc: estimated_rate = baseline_alert_rate * selected_fanout.

alex: Also add a global safety knob for platform teams to set lower caps per-tenant for b2b tenants during trials.

maria: Implementation notes: routing should enforce hard_cap before any fanout decisions and log an event with tags {tenant_id, rule_id, requested_fanout, applied_fanout}. Telemetry team: please make sure those tags are on slo.alert.fanout.enforced.

ops-bot: noted. Created infra ticket INF-3218 to add enforcement logs and tags.

kevin: We'll also add a rate-limiter on notify publisher to ensure per-tenant quota is respected even during retries.

sasha: For rollout UX: show a yellow banner for thresholds that exceed soft_warn, require a checkbox for override, and record who clicked it and why.

alex: Decision: soft_warn=4, hard_cap=8, per_tenant_quota=100/min. UI preview + override with audit log. Kevin to implement routing & telemetry changes. Sasha to own UI copy + preview. Maria to add docs blurb in console help. I'll coordinate rollout and feature flag.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Flag: feature.slo-fanout-limits = on for 10% tenants.

maria: Thanks — i'll draft the help text. Also add a quick runbook note: if we see unexpected paging spike, flip feature flag or reduce hard_cap via admin API.

alex: Perfect. @sasha @kevin loop back here once you have PRs and I'll attach to the rollout checklist. :+1:
